summary: Stonepeak-Plus Infrastructure Fund LP filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of limited partnership units under Item 3.02 and related Item 8.01 disclosure. On September 1, 2026, the Fund sold Class Z units across six series to third-party investors for aggregate consideration of roughly $52.74 million, priced at each class's August 31, 2026 Transactional NAV per unit, with final unit counts confirmed September 25, 2026. Sales were made under the Fund's continuous private offering, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D; an advisor affiliate contributed part of the consideration. No special-situation event, premium, or deal terms apply.
